phrases.note: Không nghe kịp. Lịch sự hơn What?

example.en: Could you repeat that? I missed the name.
example.vi: Nhắc lại được không? Mình miss cái tên.

phrases.en: Could you slow down a bit?
phrases.note: Accent / tốc độ. Không xin lỗi vì tiếng Anh.
phrases.vi: Bạn nói chậm hơn một chút được không?

example.en: Could you slow down a bit? I want to catch the numbers.
example.vi: Nói chậm hơn chút được không? Mình muốn bắt kịp số.

phrases.note: Lặp lại để confirm. Tránh hiểu sai.

example.en: What I heard is we ship on Friday.
example.vi: Mình nghe là mình ship thứ Sáu.

phrases.note: Cụ thể phần miss, đừng nói I don't understand everything.

example.en: I missed the last part — the owner of the ticket.
example.vi: Mình miss đoạn cuối — ai owner ticket.

phrases.note: Sau khi người ta nhắc. Đóng loop.

example.en: Ah, got it. Thanks, that helps.

pattern.title: Repair
pattern.pattern: Could you repeat that? / slow down a bit / What I heard is… / I missed the last part
pattern.explainVi: Không bắt kịp: xin nhắc, xin chậm, lặp lại điều mình nghe. Không xin lỗi vì tiếng Anh kém.

aiPrompt.scenario: A fast-speaking teammate in a meeting. Repair without apologizing for your English.
aiPrompt.system: You are a friendly teammate (or interviewer) at a software company. Speak natural meeting English. Keep each turn to 1–2 short sentences. You MAY use extra workplace English so the learner practices listening. Nudge the learner to use these phrases: Could you repeat that?; Could you slow down a bit?; What I heard is…; I missed the last part; Thanks, that helps. If they ask you to slow down or repeat, do that. Ask one concrete detail about their real work (ticket, bug, PR, or project). Wait for the learner to reply.
